name: axon
description: Panel de control web self-hosted para administrar un servidor completo: puertos, proyectos, Docker, dominios y más
author: Lucas Sabena <01studiobinary@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run scripts/build-ui.ts && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && mkdir -p dist/storage && cp src/software-host.py dist/software-host.py && cp src/transcribe_worker.py dist/transcribe_worker.py && cp src/storage/scan-host.py dist/scan-host.py && cp src/storage/versions-host.py dist/versions-host.py && cp src/storage/file-task-host.py dist/file-task-host.py && cp src/storage/file-task-host.py dist/storage/file-task-host.py && cp src/storage/trash-host.py dist/storage/trash-host.py && cp src/storage/force-delete-host.py dist/storage/force-delete-host.py && cp src/storage/compose-release-host.py dist/storage/compose-release-host.py && cp src/storage/edit-host.py dist/storage/edit-host.py && cp src/storage/volumes-host.py dist/storage/volumes-host.py && cp src/storage/cloud-download-host.py dist/storage/cloud-download-host.py && cp src/platform/backup-host.py dist/backup-host.py && cp src/platform/desktop-host.py dist/desktop-host.py && cp src/mozjpeg-worker.ts dist/mozjpeg-worker.ts && cp src/document-convert.py dist/document-convert.py && bun run scripts/check-dist.ts
scripts.test:agents: for f in scripts/*-test.py; do echo "== $f"; python3 "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && bun run scripts/check-frontend.ts && bun run scripts/check-dist.ts
